capabilities: sync the vault to a configured ZimaOS directory
browse remote ZimaOS files inside Obsidian
upload, download, preview, create folders, and delete remote files
back up local files before a remote download overwrites them
extras: Deletions are not propagated during vault sync; delete actions exist only in the cloud browser and require confirmation. Desktop-only; manual installation instructions are provided alongside community plugin listing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault to a self-hosted ZimaOS server for backup and cross-device access.

relations.evidence: OZSync syncs an Obsidian vault with ZimaOS storage for desktop backup, file browsing, and cross-device access.

summary: Vault sync plugin that backs up notes to a ZimaOS server and browses, uploads, and downloads its remote files inside Obsidian.
